features.name: Stiff-String Physical Modeling Voice Engine
features.description: Polyphonic 128-voice physical modeling synthesizer with stiff-string inharmonicity, velocity-dependent hammer hardness, 8-overtone spectrum profile, and strike point shaping.
features.expected_behavior: Generates alias-free stereo floating-point audio across 88+ keys with accurate fundamental frequency, velocity timbre scaling, and zero audio-thread allocations.

features.name: Sympathetic & Duplex Scale Resonance
features.description: String-to-string sympathetic resonance tank amplified when sustain/harmonic pedals are engaged, plus treble duplex shimmer.
features.expected_behavior: Held or undamped strings resonate sympathetically with active notes; slider intensity smoothly scales resonance energy.

features.name: Mechanical Action & Hammer/Damper/Pedal Noises
features.description: Models hammer felt impact noise, damper release thump, key release noise, and sustain pedal mechanical noise.
features.expected_behavior: Audible transient wood/felt components responsive to Hammer Noise, Hammer Tone, Damper Noise, and Pedal Noise sliders.

features.name: Tuning, Diapason, Octave Stretching & Historical Temperaments
features.description: Supports A4 Diapason (415-466 Hz), Octave Stretching, Unison Width/Balance, and 8 mathematical temperaments (Equal, Pythagorean, Zarlino, Meantone, Well-Tempered, Werckmeister III, Kirnberger III, Vallotti).
features.expected_behavior: A4 pitch matches Diapason within <0.1 Hz; non-equal temperaments match Section 17 exact frequency ratios.
features.reference_evidence: Manual Sec. 6 & Appendix 17 (pythagore, zarlino, mesotonic, welltempered, werck)

features.name: Pedal State Machine (Sustain, Soft, Sostenuto, Harmonic, Celeste, Buff, Rattle)
features.description: Full pedal state model including half-pedaling sustain, una corda soft felt shift, selective sostenuto latch, harmonic pedal, and historical pedals.
features.expected_behavior: Sustain keeps released notes alive; Sostenuto holds only keys depressed at pedal press; Soft reduces loudness and bright overtones.

features.name: PRO Per-Note Edit (Detune, Gain, Hammer Hardness, Impedance)
features.description: Per-MIDI-key physical parameter offsets for micro-tuning and voicing individual notes.
features.expected_behavior: Individual note edits adjust only the targeted MIDI key without mutating global instrument defaults.

features.name: Multi-Family Physical Instrument Catalog
features.description: Covers Concert Grands, Uprights, Electric Tines & Reeds, Clavinet, Harpsichord & Historical Fortepianos, Mallets, Steelpans, Classical Guitar, Concert Harp, and Prepared Piano.
features.expected_behavior: Switching instruments updates exciter physics, string lengths, inharmonicity, decay scales, and default DSP chain.

features.name: Preset Browser, A/B Morphing & Disk Persistence
features.description: Factory presets per instrument, continuous A/B parameter morphing slider, and user JSON preset saving/loading in XDG user data directory.
features.expected_behavior: Morphing smoothly interpolates parameters between Preset A and B; saved presets persist across restarts.

features.name: Real-Time MIDI Input Discovery, Routing & Hot-Plug
features.description: Enumerates Linux ALSA/JACK MIDI ports via midir, parses Note On/Off, CC, Pitch Bend, Aftertouch, Program Change, and detects port changes.
features.expected_behavior: Connected MIDI controllers trigger notes and pedals in real time without blocking the audio callback.

features.name: Velocity Curve LUT, Transpose, Channel Filter & 61/88/105 Key Modes
features.description: Piecewise-linear velocity remapping, -36..+36 semitone transpose, channel filtering, 16-channel microtonal mode, and CC Learn automation.
features.expected_behavior: Velocity curve reshapes soft/hard response; transpose shifts note numbers accurately; CC mappings modulate engine parameters.

features.name: Low-Latency Linux Audio Engine (PipeWire/ALSA/JACK) & Telemetry
features.description: cpal real-time stereo output stream with headless fallback, lock-free command queue, RMS/peak metering, active voice count, latency and CPU telemetry.
features.expected_behavior: Runs smoothly at host sample rate (44.1/48 kHz) without xruns or panics even when audio device is unavailable.

features.name: Offline WAV Export
features.description: Exports deterministic stereo floating-point WAV audio files using hound through the full synthesis + effects pipeline.
features.expected_behavior: Produces valid non-empty RIFF/WAVE files free of NaNs or hard digital clipping.

features.name: 3-Mic Acoustic Stage, Lid Position, Stereo Width & Binaural Mode
features.description: Virtual microphone positioning with delay/level compensation, lid acoustic attenuation, M/S stereo width, and binaural head crossfeed.
features.expected_behavior: Closing the lid attenuates upper harmonics; toggling binaural mode applies spatial interaural cues.

features.name: Equalizer, 3 FX Slots (Delay/Chorus/Tremolo/Comp), Reverb & Limiter
features.description: Multi-band peaking EQ, 3 configurable DSP effect slots, stereo algorithmic reverb with damping/highpass, and soft-knee brickwall limiter.
features.expected_behavior: Each stage alters output signal measurably while limiter caps peaks below 0 dBFS.

features.name: Studio Main Window, Interactive 88/105-Key Keyboard & Computer Keyboard Input
features.description: Tauri 2 desktop window with top instrument/preset/morphing bar, real-time VU/CPU/voice telemetry, interactive 88/105-key piano keyboard, and 4 interactive pedals.
features.expected_behavior: Clicking keys or pressing computer keys plays notes with velocity scaling; active MIDI notes highlight in real time.

features.name: Interactive Editors (Velocity Curve Canvas, 2D Mic Stage, Note Edit, MIDI Learn)
features.description: Dedicated visual editors for dragging velocity curve control points, positioning virtual mics on piano soundboard, per-key PRO Note Edit, and MIDI CC mapping.
features.expected_behavior: Interactive editors sync bidirectionally with Rust engine state without UI lag.

features.name: Complete 215-Parameter LV2 & Manual Capability Extraction
features.description: Structured extraction of all 215 LV2 parameters, ranges, defaults, and manual instrument/feature descriptions into docs/REFERENCE_PARAMETERS.json.
features.expected_behavior: Every Pianoteq 9.3.1 public parameter and instrument entry is documented with verified evidence.
